body_markdown:
Hey all,


Award season is here and we’re proud to share that Opera has won a Best of the Best[Red Dot Award](https://www.red-dot.org/project/opera-neon-90415) .


## Red Dot: Best of the Best


The Red Dot Award: Design Concept looks at the idea behind a project as well as the quality of its design, while Best of the Best goes to the most groundbreaking work in each category. We received it in the Artificial Intelligence category for the design concept behind Opera Neon.


This is important recognition for our team, who have spent the past years bringing agentic workflows into the browser. We’ve always built Opera as a browser that tries new ideas early, and it’s good to see a design jury recognize that.


We’re bringing new technology into all of our browsers, and we recently added[local AI models to Opera One](https://blogs.opera.com/news/2026/10/webai-local-ai-for-the-web-now-in-opera/) , for example.


## A closer look at the design


Let’s go over some of the design concepts that Opera Neon presents.


The Start Page brings its four core AI agents, Chat, Do, Make and ODRA, together in one place, along with a growing set of more specialized ones.


The main design choice is the dual tab bar. One bar holds your web tabs, and the other groups them into Tasks, so each piece of work has its own workspace and the AI has the full context of what you’re doing.


You can also attach Cards to your prompts, which are reusable instructions that save you from explaining the same thing twice. Changing something as familiar as the tab bar is never a small decision, so it’s especially nice to see the result recognized by a design jury.


## Try the browser behind the award


This award joins a slew of other recent awards like[four iF Design Awards](https://opr.as/xkos) , and two Lovie awards in each of[2024](https://blogs.opera.com/news/2024/11/opera-brings-home-pair-of-lovie-awards/) and[2025](https://blogs.opera.com/news/2025/11/opera-wins-two-back-to-back-lovie-awards/) . Thank you to our teams for the work behind this project, and to everyone who uses Opera Neon, since none of this would have happened without you!


If you’d like to try Opera Neon you can download it[here](https://www.operaneon.com/) , and if you want to hear what we’re working on next, you can sign up for our newsletter at the bottom of this page.


Until next time!
